predecessors.name: British Africa (remaining colonies)
predecessors.text: Nyasaland, the British protectorate (the former British Central Africa Protectorate)

ledger.x: 6 July 1964: Nyasaland becomes independent as Malawi under Hastings Banda.
6 July 1966: Malawi becomes a republic with Banda as president.
1975: the capital moves from Zomba to Lilongwe.

certainty.note: Neither page opened gives a boundary treaty or survey: the Malawi page only says it is 'bordered by Zambia to the northwest, Tanzania to the northeast, and Mozambique to the south, southwest, and east', and no page records a frontier…
